tags.title: Warlock
tags.lyrics-eng:
War!
I’m your warlock!
War!
I’m your warlock!
War! War!

Fortune to be told, moving in an unusual manner
Underlying to be seen,
within the power is a planter
Fortune to be told, moving in an unusual manner
Underlying to be seen,
within the power is a planter
War!
I’m in your walls, look for my eyes, I watch you fall

Cause I’m your war!

War!

I’m your warlock!
War!

I’m your warlock!
Fortune to be told, moving in an unusual manner
Underlying to be seen,
within the power is a planter
Fortune to be told, moving in an unusual manner
Underlying to be seen,
within the power is a planter

War!

I’m in your walls, look for my eyes, I watch you fall

Cause I’m your war! War!

I’m your warlock!
War!
I’m your warlock!
